title: Mobility Equipment Records Register Standard — Open Wheelchair Records per Patient
content:
# Open Wheelchair Records per Patient — Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** A patient may hold at most 2 open Mobility Equipment wheelchair records — an open record being one in any status other than returned, cancelled or replaced: at most one billed to coverage, plus self-pay chairs. A coverage-billed order is never opened while another coverage-billed chair order of the patient is in the status order received.

## What counts as open

| Wheelchair record status | Open for this standard |
|---|---|
| order received | yes |
| rental active | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| patient owned | yes |
| returned | no |
| cancelled | no |
| replaced | no |

## The pending-order condition

The condition on opening a coverage-billed order is read from the system records, before the order is opened, across the wheelchair records of the same patient: the patient's other coverage-billed chair orders and their statuses. A coverage-billed chair order of that patient still in order received means a new coverage-billed order is not opened; what the patient says about the earlier order does not replace the record.

## Combinations within the limit (derived)

With a ceiling of 2 open records and at most one of them billed to coverage, the open records a patient can hold are:

- one coverage-billed record alone;
- one coverage-billed record and one self-pay record;
- one or two self-pay records with no coverage-billed record.

Two coverage-billed open records, or any third open record, fall outside the standard.

## Points of judgement

- **Does a returned or cancelled chair still count?** No; returned, cancelled and replaced records are not open.
- **Hypothetical case.** A patient holds one rental-active coverage-billed chair and one patient-owned self-pay chair. Both are open, so the patient is at the ceiling of 2.
